doc.digest: Output numbers by moving a slider onscreen
doc.description: live.slider is a user interface object that resembles a sliding potentiometer.

methods.name: bang
methods.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
methods.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

methods.name: int
methods.digest: Store, display, and output a number
methods.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed by the live.slider object and sent out the outlet.

methods.name: float
methods.digest: Store, display, and output a number
methods.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed by the live.slider object and sent out the outlet.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: The word assign, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out the live.slider object's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, the assign message will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

methods.name: init
methods.digest: Restore and output the initial value
methods.description: Restore and output the initial value.

methods.name: (mouse)
methods.digest: Click and drag in the slider to change the value.
methods.description: Click and drag in the slider to change the value. Hold down the Shift key for more precise mouse control.

methods.name: outputvalue
methods.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
methods.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

methods.name: rawfloat
methods.digest: Store a raw normalized value, convert to real, display, and output
methods.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, stored, displayed by live.slider, and the current value is sent out the outlet.

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set and display the current value without triggering output
methods.description: Sets and displays the current value without triggering any output.
